lines.ruling: Ruling: model error on shown_when; the reply shows the whole-dollar line only when the amount is more than zero. The project shows it on every record, as the source requires a record for every W-2: IT-201-I p. 21, "You must complete a W-2 record for each W-2 you receive, even if it does not show any New York State, New York City (NYC), or Yonkers wages or tax withheld." The value expressions are the same (half-up to the dollar; IT-2 p. 2, "drop amounts below 50 cents and increase amounts from 50 to 99 cents to the next dollar").
